name: Black-crested Titmouse
desc: Black-crested Titmouse (Baeolophus atricristatus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 68 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The black-crested titmouse or Mexican titmouse, is a passerine bird in the family Paridae, the tits and chickadees. It is found in Mexico and the U. S.
